text: 65分、Seabrook Townは2-1で追いかけるため、攻撃のやり方を変えました。より前からプレッシャーをかけて、ボールを早くゴールに持っていく直接的な攻めを増やしました。これでシュートチャンスの期待度（xG）が0.45から0.61に上がり、少し得点の可能性が増えました[#1361]。ただ、相手のHarbour Cityも守りをうまくかわしていて、試合はまだまだ動きそうです[#1361]。

Increasing directness likely aimed to expedite crossing opportunities by quicker vertical progression rather than patient buildup [#1361].
- The elevated pressing reflected by a higher press metric (0.84 from 0.66) and increased line height (0.72 from 0.6) aimed to reduce Harbour City’s patient short passing rhythm, typical of their 4-2-3-1 shape, by disrupting their midfield control earlier [#1361].

Seabrook Town’s style shift reflects an urgent move to create chances by quicker direct play rather than maintaining their usual wide crossing pattern [#1361].
